_why: commons dir registry (owner of directory roles). A station adds rows in map/station_dirs.json (station-only). readme: none = this row is the description (the dir's files belong to another slice); map/ and brain/ READMEs are generated.
_why_root_ceiling: off on the commons: a station root adds ~10 station-only entries (station.json, .env, lanes...); a station may set its own ceiling in map/station_dirs.json
_why_station_only: KIT_PLAN 3.3 station-only class: a commons doc may name these; check_paths gates them only on a station branch

never_holds: upstream agent files (they are neutralised into the lanes)
.claude.role: Claude Code wiring: settings.json, commons hooks, the commons skill set and workflows.

holds: <slice>.md (one return file per child slice: status, changes, finding dispositions, audit tails)
RETURNS.role: Child-slice return files the prime reads when a delegated slice finishes (operator-ordered RETURNS/<slice>.md).

never_holds: upstream memory systems (one paper node points at each)
brain.role: The station's memory: one node per file, the loop register, checkpoints and handoffs; read by tools/brain.py.

commons.role: Kit-wide constants, schemas, shared method packs and the commons manifest.

governance.role: Rules, checks, decisions, ledger, defects, releases: the one owner of precedence and of every rule's enforcement.

map.role: The mapping programme's registries and generated views: what is here, has it been built, is it used, do the docs tell the truth.

nc-lane.role: Held lane: CC BY-NC material, never exported commercially.

registry.role: Kit-wide registries on main: sources and pins, homes, licences, telemetry, attic, quarantine, skill assignment and index.

repertoire.role: Held lane: permissive upstream method text, neutralised at ingest; read-only to agents.

router.role: Intent routing data: the commons rows, programme fragments and the kit decision tree.

study.role: Held lane: material held for study first (AutoHedge), disarmed by default.

tools.role: Every script the kit runs: stdlib Python, one programme per subfolder.

upstream.role: Held lane: copyleft/whole upstream trees held unmodified + the station's upstream ledgers.

meta.purpose: stable-kit main: the shared core and the decision tree

placement._why: scripts live in one place; held lanes are never placement-checked
